concept: ELB: ALB for L7 path-based routing
tests: Choosing a load balancer that can route HTTP(S) by URL path to different target groups.
expected: Application Load Balancer — L7, path-based and host-based routing to target groups. Triggers: "based on the URL path", "/api vs /images", "HTTPS microservices".
why_not: NLB — L4, can't see the URL; GWLB — for inline appliances (firewalls); Classic LB — legacy, no modern path routing.
